versos.grego: Συνίστημι δὲ ὑμῖν Φοίβην τὴν ἀδελφὴν ἡμῶν, οὖσαν διάκονον τῆς ἐκκλησίας τῆς ἐν Κενχρεαῖς,

controles.web: I commend to you Phoebe, our sister, who is a servant of the assembly that is at Cenchreae,
controles.kjv: I commend unto you Phebe our sister, which is a servant of the church which is at Cenchrea:
controles.livre: Eu vos recomendo a nossa irmã Febe, que é servidora da Igreja que está em Cencreia,

versos.grego: ἵνα αὐτὴν προσδέξησθε ἐν Κυρίῳ ἀξίως τῶν ἁγίων, καὶ παραστῆτε αὐτῇ ἐν ᾧ ἂν ὑμῶν χρῄζῃ πράγματι· καὶ γὰρ αὐτὴ προστάτις πολλῶν ἐγενήθη καὶ ἐμοῦ αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: that you receive her in the Lord, in a way worthy of the saints, and that you assist her in whatever matter she may need from you, for she herself also has been a helper of many, and of my own self.
controles.kjv: That ye receive her in the Lord, as becometh saints, and that ye assist her in whatsoever business she hath need of you: for she hath been a succourer of many, and of myself also.
controles.livre: para que a recebais no Senhor, como convém aos santos; e para que a ajudeis em qualquer coisa que necessitar de vós; pois ela tem ajudado a muitos, inclusive a mim mesmo.

versos.grego: Ἀσπάσασθε Πρίσκαν καὶ Ἀκύλαν τοὺς συνεργούς μου ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ,

controles.web: Greet Prisca and Aquila, my fellow workers in Christ Jesus,
controles.kjv: Greet Priscilla and Aquila my helpers in Christ Jesus:
controles.livre: Saudai a Prisca  e a Áquila, meus cooperadores em Cristo Jesus,

versos.grego: οἵτινες ὑπὲρ τῆς ψυχῆς μου τὸν ἑαυτῶν τράχηλον ὑπέθηκαν, οἷς οὐκ ἐγὼ μόνος εὐχαριστῶ ἀλλὰ καὶ πᾶσαι αἱ ἐκκλησίαι τῶν ἐθνῶν,

controles.web: who for my life, laid down their own necks; to whom not only I give thanks, but also all the assemblies of the Gentiles.
controles.kjv: Who have for my life laid down their own necks: unto whom not only I give thanks, but also all the churches of the Gentiles.
controles.livre: que arriscaram seus pescoços por minha vida; a eles não somente eu agradeço, como também todas as igrejas dos gentios.

versos.grego: καὶ τὴν κατ’ οἶκον αὐτῶν ἐκκλησίαν. ἀσπάσασθε Ἐπαίνετον τὸν ἀγαπητόν μου, ὅς ἐστιν ἀπαρχὴ τῆς Ἀσίας εἰς Χριστόν.

controles.web: Greet the assembly that is in their house. Greet Epaenetus, my beloved, who is the first fruits of Achaia to Christ.
controles.kjv: Likewise greet the church that is in their house. Salute my wellbeloved Epenetus, who is the firstfruits of Achaia unto Christ.
controles.livre: Saudai também a igreja que se reúne na casa deles. Saudai Epêneto, meu amado, que é o primeiro fruto  da Ásia para Cristo.

versos.grego: ἀσπάσασθε Μαριάν, ἥτις πολλὰ ἐκοπίασεν εἰς ὑμᾶς.

controles.web: Greet Mary, who labored much for us.
controles.kjv: Greet Mary, who bestowed much labour on us.
controles.livre: Saudai Maria, que trabalhou muito por vós.

versos.grego: ἀσπάσασθε Ἀνδρόνικον καὶ Ἰουνίαν τοὺς συγγενεῖς μου καὶ συναιχμαλώτους μου, οἵτινές εἰσιν ἐπίσημοι ἐν τοῖς ἀποστόλοις, οἳ καὶ πρὸ ἐμοῦ γέγοναν ἐν Χριστῷ.

controles.web: Greet Andronicus and Junia, my relatives and my fellow prisoners, who are notable among the apostles, who also were in Christ before me.
controles.kjv: Salute Andronicus and Junia, my kinsmen, and my fellowprisoners, who are of note among the apostles, who also were in Christ before me.
controles.livre: Saudai Andrônico e Júnia, meus parentes,  e meus companheiros na prisão, que são notáveis entre os apóstolos, e também estavam antes de mim em Cristo.

versos.grego: ἀσπάσασθε Ἀμπλιᾶτον τὸν ἀγαπητόν μου ἐν Κυρίῳ.

controles.web: Greet Amplias, my beloved in the Lord.
controles.kjv: Greet Amplias my beloved in the Lord.
controles.livre: Saudai Amplíato, meu amado no Senhor.

versos.grego: ἀσπάσασθε Οὐρβανὸν τὸν συνεργὸν ἡμῶν ἐν Χριστῷ καὶ Στάχυν τὸν ἀγαπητόν μου.

controles.web: Greet Urbanus, our fellow worker in Christ, and Stachys, my beloved.
controles.kjv: Salute Urbane, our helper in Christ, and Stachys my beloved.
controles.livre: Saudai Urbano, nosso cooperador em Cristo, e Estáquis, meu amado.

versos.grego: ἀσπάσασθε Ἀπελλῆν τὸν δόκιμον ἐν Χριστῷ. ἀσπάσασθε τοὺς ἐκ τῶν Ἀριστοβούλου.

controles.web: Greet Apelles, the approved in Christ. Greet those who are of the household of Aristobulus.
controles.kjv: Salute Apelles approved in Christ. Salute them which are of Aristobulus’ household.
controles.livre: Saudai Apeles, aprovado em Cristo. Saudai os que são da casa  de Aristóbulo.

versos.grego: ἀσπάσασθε Ἡρῳδίωνα τὸν συγγενῆ μου. ἀσπάσασθε τοὺς ἐκ τῶν Ναρκίσσου τοὺς ὄντας ἐν Κυρίῳ.

controles.web: Greet Herodion, my kinsman. Greet them of the household of Narcissus, who are in the Lord.
controles.kjv: Salute Herodion my kinsman. Greet them that be of the household of Narcissus, which are in the Lord.
controles.livre: Saudai Herodião, meu parente.  Saudai os que são da casa de Narciso, que estão no Senhor.

versos.grego: ἀσπάσασθε Τρύφαιναν καὶ Τρυφῶσαν τὰς κοπιώσας ἐν Κυρίῳ. ἀσπάσασθε Περσίδα τὴν ἀγαπητήν, ἥτις πολλὰ ἐκοπίασεν ἐν Κυρίῳ.

controles.web: Greet Tryphaena and Tryphosa, who labor in the Lord. Greet Persis, the beloved, who labored much in the Lord.
controles.kjv: Salute Tryphena and Tryphosa, who labour in the Lord. Salute the beloved Persis, which laboured much in the Lord.
controles.livre: Saudai Trifena e Trifosa, que trabalham no Senhor. Saudai a amada Pérside, que trabalhou muito no Senhor.

versos.grego: ἀσπάσασθε Ῥοῦφον τὸν ἐκλεκτὸν ἐν Κυρίῳ καὶ τὴν μητέρα αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐμοῦ.

controles.web: Greet Rufus, the chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.
controles.kjv: Salute Rufus chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.
controles.livre: Saudai Rufo, o escolhido no Senhor, e a mãe dele, e minha também.

versos.grego: ἀσπάσασθε Ἀσύνκριτον, Φλέγοντα, Ἑρμῆν, Πατρόβαν, Ἑρμᾶν, καὶ τοὺς σὺν αὐτοῖς ἀδελφούς.

controles.web: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, and the brothers  who are with them.
controles.kjv: Salute Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermas, Patrobas, Hermes, and the brethren which are with them.
controles.livre: Saudai Asíncrito, Flegonte, Hermes, Pátrobas, Hermas e os irmãos que estão com eles.

versos.grego: ἀσπάσασθε Φιλόλογον καὶ Ἰουλίαν, Νηρέα καὶ τὴν ἀδελφὴν αὐτοῦ, καὶ Ὀλυμπᾶν, καὶ τοὺς σὺν αὐτοῖς πάντας ἁγίους.

controles.web: Greet Philologus and Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints who are with them.
controles.kjv: Salute Philologus, and Julia, Nereus, and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints which are with them.
controles.livre: Saudai Filólogo, Júlia, Nereu e sua irmã, Olimpas, e todos os santos que estão com eles.

versos.grego: ἀσπάσασθε ἀλλήλους ἐν φιλήματι ἁγίῳ. ἀσπάζονται ὑμᾶς αἱ ἐκκλησίαι πᾶσαι τοῦ Χριστοῦ.

controles.web: Greet one another with a holy kiss. The assemblies of Christ greet you.
controles.kjv: Salute one another with an holy kiss. The churches of Christ salute you.
controles.livre: Saudai-vos uns aos outros com beijo santo. igrejas de Cristo vos saúdam.

versos.grego: Παρακαλῶ δὲ ὑμᾶς, ἀδελφοί, σκοπεῖν τοὺς τὰς διχοστασίας καὶ τὰ σκάνδαλα παρὰ τὴν διδαχὴν ἣν ὑμεῖς ἐμάθετε ποιοῦντας, καὶ ἐκκλίνετε ἀπ’ αὐτῶν·

controles.web: Now I beg you, brothers, look out for those who are causing the divisions and occasions of stumbling, contrary to the doctrine which you learned, and turn away from them.
controles.kjv: Now I beseech you, brethren, mark them which cause divisions and offences contrary to the doctrine which ye have learned; and avoid them.
controles.livre: E rogo-vos, irmãos, que sejais cuidadosos com os que causam divisões e ofensas  contrárias a doutrina que aprendestes; e afastai-vos deles;

versos.grego: οἱ γὰρ τοιοῦτοι τῷ Κυρίῳ ἡμῶν Χριστῷ οὐ δουλεύουσιν ἀλλὰ τῇ ἑαυτῶν κοιλίᾳ, καὶ διὰ τῆς χρηστολογίας καὶ εὐλογίας ἐξαπατῶσιν τὰς καρδίας τῶν ἀκάκων.

controles.web: For those who are such don’t serve our Lord, Jesus Christ, but their own belly; and by their smooth and flattering speech, they deceive the hearts of the innocent.
controles.kjv: For they that are such serve not our Lord Jesus Christ, but their own belly; and by good words and fair speeches deceive the hearts of the simple.
controles.livre: pois tais pessoas não servem ao nosso Senhor Cristo,  mas sim, ao próprio ventre; e com palavras suaves e elogios enganam os corações dos ingênuos.

versos.grego: ἡ γὰρ ὑμῶν ὑπακοὴ εἰς πάντας ἀφίκετο· ἐφ’ ὑμῖν οὖν χαίρω, θέλω δὲ ὑμᾶς σοφοὺς εἶναι εἰς τὸ ἀγαθόν, ἀκεραίους δὲ εἰς τὸ κακόν.

controles.web: For your obedience has become known to all. I rejoice therefore over you. But I desire to have you wise in that which is good, but innocent in that which is evil.
controles.kjv: For your obedience is come abroad unto all men. I am glad therefore on your behalf: but yet I would have you wise unto that which is good, and simple concerning evil.
controles.livre: Pois a vossa obediência chegou ao conhecimento de todos. Por isso eu me alegro por vossa causa; quero, porém, que sejais sábios no bem, e inocentes quanto ao mal.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ Θεὸς τῆς εἰρήνης συντρίψει τὸν Σατανᾶν ὑπὸ τοὺς πόδας ὑμῶν ἐν τάχει. Ἡ χάρις τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ μεθ’ ὑμῶν.

controles.web: And the God of peace will quickly crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
controles.kjv: And the God of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.
controles.livre: E o Deus de paz esmagará Satanás em pedaços debaixo dos vossos pés. A graça de nosso Senhor Jesus seja convosco.

versos.grego: Ἀσπάζεται ὑμᾶς Τιμόθεος ὁ συνεργός μου, καὶ Λούκιος καὶ Ἰάσων καὶ Σωσίπατρος οἱ συγγενεῖς μου.

controles.web: Timothy, my fellow worker, greets you, as do Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater, my relatives.
controles.kjv: Timotheus my workfellow, and Lucius, and Jason, and Sosipater, my kinsmen, salute you.
controles.livre: Saúdam-vos o meu cooperador Timóteo, e os meus parentes  Lúcio, Jáson, e Sosípatro.

versos.grego: ἀσπάζομαι ὑμᾶς ἐγὼ Τέρτιος ὁ γράψας τὴν ἐπιστολὴν ἐν Κυρίῳ.

controles.web: I, Tertius, who write the letter, greet you in the Lord.
controles.kjv: I Tertius, who wrote this epistle, salute you in the Lord.
controles.livre: Eu, Tércio, que escrevi esta carta, vos saúdo no Senhor.

versos.grego: ἀσπάζεται ὑμᾶς Γάϊος ὁ ξένος μου καὶ ὅλης τῆς ἐκκλησίας. ἀσπάζεται ὑμᾶς Ἔραστος ὁ οἰκονόμος τῆς πόλεως καὶ Κούαρτος ὁ ἀδελφός.

controles.web: Gaius, my host and host of the whole assembly, greets you. Erastus, the treasurer of the city, greets you, as does Quartus, the brother.
controles.kjv: Gaius mine host, and of the whole church, saluteth you. Erastus the chamberlain of the city saluteth you, and Quartus a brother.
controles.livre: Gaio, hospedeiro meu e toda a igreja, vos saúda. Erasto, tesoureiro da cidade, vos saúda, e também o irmão Quarto.

versos.grego: Τῷ δὲ δυναμένῳ ὑμᾶς στηρίξαι κατὰ τὸ εὐαγγέλιόν μου καὶ τὸ κήρυγμα Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, κατὰ ἀποκάλυψιν μυστηρίου χρόνοις αἰωνίοις σεσιγημένου,

controles.kjv: Now to him that is of power to stablish you according to my gospel, and the preaching of Jesus Christ, according to the revelation of the mystery, which was kept secret since the world began,
controles.livre: Ora, para aquele que tem o poder de vos manter firmes segundo o meu Evangelho e a pregação de Jesus Cristo, conforme a revelação do mistério, que foi encoberto desde o princípio dos tempos;

versos.grego: φανερωθέντος δὲ νῦν διά τε γραφῶν προφητικῶν κατ’ ἐπιταγὴν τοῦ αἰωνίου Θεοῦ εἰς ὑπακοὴν πίστεως εἰς πάντα τὰ ἔθνη γνωρισθέντος,

controles.kjv: But now is made manifest, and by the scriptures of the prophets, according to the commandment of the everlasting God, made known to all nations for the obedience of faith:
controles.livre: Mas agora se manifestou, e se tornou conhecido pelas Escrituras dos profetas, segundo o mandado do Deus eterno, para a obediência da fé entre todas as nações;

versos.grego: μόνῳ σοφῷ Θεῷ, διὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, ᾧ ἡ δόξα εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων· ἀμήν.

controles.kjv: To God only wise, be glory through Jesus Christ for ever. Amen.  Written to the Romans from Corinthus, and sent by Phebe servant of the church at Cenchrea.
controles.livre: Ao único Deus sábio seja a glória, por meio de Jesus Cristo, para todo o sempre! Amém!
